Method: Wilson 95% interval for both control (base Qwen2.5) and variant (sovereign fine-tune) win-rates. McNemar exact test on discordant pairs. A win requires the p95 CI not overlap and McNemar p<0.05. ⚠ This is the honest answer: Base Qwen2.5-0.5B beats every sovereign fine-tune we own on every governance axis we can measure. The path forward is retrieval over statute text (base Qwen + small-model retrieval router), not weight-merge of weak specialists. The instrument wins, not the model. 🧬 Experimental Design — how the harness decides Wilson 95% CI for the win-rate: k/n ± 1.96·√(p(1-p)/n + 1.96²/(4n²)) / (1 + 1.96²/n) — proper for small n, asymmetric around the point estimate. McNemar exact test on discordant pairs: p = min(1, 2·Σ Binom(n=k..b+c, p=0.5)) — only counts items where one model is right and the other is wrong. Both-right and both-wrong cancel out. Verdict logic : requires (a) n ≥ usable_n=30 and (b) McNemar p < 0.05. Otherwise UNMEASURED or NO_SIGNIFICANT_DIFFERENCE. exp_register Register control + variant + axis + items. Returns eid. exp_record Record one comparison (winner, both-correct flags). Discordants feed McNemar. exp_analyze Wilson CI for both + McNemar p + verdict. MEASURED only at n≥30. exp_list All experiments with current state (n, label, status). exp_conclude Signed conclusion (32-char sig) — only valid if MEASURED. All 11 tests pass on the pod. Ed25519-style hash sigs (sha256 truncated).
